family: Largest mean available German gas compiled member group, with all its tranches. Remove its hourly MW in the window; replace with one full-or-reject minimum-output parent and hourly divisible remaining-volume children.
parent_price: Volume-weighted inherited resource_full tranche costs for the minimum-output profile plus startup_eur_per_mw * maximum family MW / parent MWh
assumptions: Window, minimum output and startup cost are untuned synthetic package assumptions, not measured plant characteristics. Existing fitted bids may already absorb commitment costs. This is an order-semantics/runtime pilot, not an empirical startup correction.
limits: Exactly three daily controls and three linked cases; 10-second limit per optimization, 5GiB address-space cap, one worker thread. No annual run, target fit, new hydro schedule, baseline replacement or website change.
pricing: Fixed-integer dispatch LP plus dual feasibility search for leaf/subtree nonnegative surplus in single-parent forests. Preserve failed price searches; no master price cuts, MIC, market tick rounding or full EUPHEMIA compliance.

sources.sections: Block/linked-order tutorial; inflexible parent and flexible hourly children

decomposition: Exactly solve the four linked hours together; reuse the exact accepted witness for the other twenty independent hours. Replay all24 network hours. This factorization is valid only because no submitted order or temporal physical constraint crosses components; arbitrary daily storage requires its entire connected time component.
numerical_zero: Rectify only inconsistent lower/upper pairs within1e-7MW (e.g. inherited -7e-15MW upper with zero lower). Verify the original unrectified network after solving; no physical capacity correction.
